about_the_game:
Welcome To The Zone...

Big Boss, an old pal offering you fame and wealth inside Avalon, a safe zone built to keep the horrors inside The Zone out. You'll be given a van, a weapon, and just enough scrap to buy yourself a trip inside The Zone to find untouched piles of loot! ...Wait, what do you mean theirs a twist?! Big Boss is the man supplying all this, and he won't be happy if you don't bring back those supplies! After being assigned a quota for loot and a deadline, you'll be trusted to ensure he gets his share. Now, if you come home with extra, good for you, that's extra dough to weigh down your pockets.

Don't go it alone!

The Zone is a nasty place, but bringing friends can make it easier to not die! Don't worry, Big Boss will supply them with weapons too, so you won't need to spend any of your money on getting the essentials. Drag your friend into the grave The Zone with you and grab all that nice loot! Did you're friend go down? Don't worry, you can bring them home with you and save all their stuff AND them! Or leave them behind to ensure you get out safely..

Extract early, last minute, or not at all.

When in The Zone, a timer will appear on your HUD, telling you how much longer you have until your inevitable death. You have three options; Extract early, and possibly hit another location in The Zone before heading back to Avalon, extract right before your time limit, or not at all... Being left in The Zone after time runs out means you'll be forced to survive an all out assault. Survive long enough, and you may just get another chance at extraction.

content_descriptors.notes: While you are playing Upon Dusk, you will encounter scenes that include violence and gore. These scenes could be during the time where you control your character, or when there is a cutscene.

short_description: Welcome to the world of Upon Dusk, a new PvE survival shooter, with a twist! In this game, you and up to 3 friends will have to find enough loot to make Big Boss happy! Will you survive the horrors waiting for you in the Zone, or will you upset Big Boss and not find enough loot?..
